sasha: quick standup — WHAT I DID: landed promptset cleanup for es/multi-lang, ran evals for llama3-smallq on nightly queue.
BLOCKERS: failing qa gate on paraphrase tests (see below), can't reproduce locally.
TODAY: try bisect prompt changes, open CR for promptset, ping infra if builds flake.

maria: which test is failing? stack trace?

sasha: failing test is `paraphrase-coherence` in eval harness, bot shows 12% drop.
logs:
```
AssertionError: expected >=0.85, got 0.73
Trace: eval/paraphrase_coherence.py:42
```
Can't repro on my mac — env maybe uses different tokenizer.

arun: I'll take a look — can you paste the prompt diff? also tag me on the CR. Might be tokenization padding change.

sasha: uploaded diff here: https://git.redwood/repo/PR/4321 — short change, removed clarifying sentence from few templates.

jon: heads-up: if we revert that sentence we might regress answer specificity. maybe can tweak scoring threshold instead? cc @maria

maria: lowering threshold could mask real regressions. prefer to bisect and fix template.

olivia: I saw similar drop yesterday on dedicated nightly — opened a ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INF-989
attached a run with `runtest --model llama3-smallq --seed 42` that reproduces on CI.

eval-bot: automated-run 1745559889: paraphrase-coherence failed for build 2026-03-17T22:00Z; delta -0.12 :warning:

arun: ok pulling CI run now. if it's tokenizer we can add normalize step in harness quick fix while Sasha bisects.

sasha: thanks. I'll start bisect now. leaving a TODO on the PR for revert vs patch.

jon: small ask — can someone review my CR for prompt-metrics dashboard? it's tiny. https://git.redwood/repo/PR/4330 :eyes:

maria: I can review in an hour.

olivia: FYI I'll be OOO from 17:00 PT — ping @arun for infra certs.

sasha: noted. will keep updates here. :thumbsup:
